title: Keep top filter buttons wrapped at every viewport width

comments.author: home
comments.text: Declared behavior: the top filter rail must wrap its buttons into visible rows at every viewport width and must not horizontally scroll or clip controls.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Merged in PR #78 as ca6811c. Browser verification at 390px and 1440px confirmed no filter-rail overflow; the focused regression test passes.
